g.text: An equilibrium phase diagram and a heat-treatment time path answer different questions

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Both diagrams are assigned teaching models, not an actual binary-alloy phase diagram or alloy-specific heat-treatment schedule. Liquidus/solidus meet at
pure-component endpoints and bound an L+α field. The thermal path demonstrates heating, holding, rapid cooling, and reheating. Actual transformations
require the alloy’s thermodynamics and time-temperature kinetics; no martensite or heat-treatment suitability is implied for this illustrative isomorphous
